elements.name: wide elevated view of large bus station yard
long rows of parked long-distance buses
tall lamp posts with warm light
many small dark figures moving between buses
dark city with a few lit windows behind

wrong_setting: The skyline reads as a generic European city, with church spires and a dome on the left; nothing identifies it as Addis Ababa.
notes: Clear the walking figures out of the bottom foreground and blank the lettered number plate on the centre bus. Add visible dust haze in the lamp light, replace the spired European skyline with a lower Addis Ababa skyline, and remove the odd post propping up the right-hand bus.
